# netinf

(Version 0.1.0, updated on 2026-09-29)

**(Work-in-progress. Not ready for use)**

`netinf` is an R package for identifying influential cases in network
analysis. It complements the `bootnet` package by adding a complete
workflow for influence diagnostics: extracting case indices from
bootstrap samples, computing empirical influence values, validating
candidate cases via leave-one-out and leave-multiple-out analysis, and
quantifying centrality changes via a generalized Cook’s distance.

For more information on this package, please visit its GitHub page:

<https://yangborui859-maker.github.io/netinf/>

## Getting started

For a detailed walkthrough, see the [Getting started
guide](https://yangborui859-maker.github.io/netinf/articles/netinf-guide.md).

## Installation

``` r

install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("yangborui859-maker/netinf")
```

## Issues

If you have any suggestions and found any bugs, please feel free to open
a GitHub issue. Thanks.

  : Calculate Empirical Influence Values
- [`gcds_md_plot()`](https://yangborui859-maker.github.io/netinf/reference/gcds_md_plot.md)
  : Plot gCD Against Mahalanobis Distance and Mean Centrality Change
- [`gcds_plot()`](https://yangborui859-maker.github.io/netinf/reference/gcds_plot.md)
  : Plot Case Influence on Centrality Against gCD
- [`influence_diagnostic()`](https://yangborui859-maker.github.io/netinf/reference/influence_diagnostic.md)
  : Case Influence Diagnostic for Network Models
- [`influence_plot()`](https://yangborui859-maker.github.io/netinf/reference/influence_plot.md)
  : Plot Empirical Influence Values
- [`leave_one_out_analysis()`](https://yangborui859-maker.github.io/netinf/reference/leave_one_out_analysis.md)
  : Leave-One-Out Analysis for Influential Cases
- [`print(`*`<empiricalInfluence>`*`)`](https://yangborui859-maker.github.io/netinf/reference/print.empiricalInfluence.md)
  : Print Method for empiricalInfluence Objects
- [`print(`*`<influenceDiagnostic>`*`)`](https://yangborui859-maker.github.io/netinf/reference/print.influenceDiagnostic.md)
  : Print Method for influenceDiagnostic Objects
